prompts.prompt: Create ONE finished premium landscape 16:9 film illustration, not a storyboard or collage. This is original imagery for a fictional corporate AI takeover, no existing film characters. Scene 1 THE CORPORATION: an elegant detailed modern Japanese corporate headquarters with a warm sandstone lower atrium and tall glass upper facade in convincing three-quarter perspective, slightly rounded glass corner, stepped roof garden, tree-lined city street, detailed reflections of old city architecture in windows, bicycles, carefully drawn pedestrians entering, hedges and lush foliage. Establish a distinctive building with a central vertical glazed atrium and a copper-colored entrance canopy for later reuse. Recurring people near entrance: a 40-year-old Japanese woman with a short dark auburn bob in a cream blazer carrying a dark satchel; a Japanese man about 50 with salt-and-pepper hair and charcoal suit carrying a slim laptop case. Emotion: peaceful ordinary work morning with faint underlying unease. Sophisticated animated-film production painting; anatomically credible hands and faces; premium composition, not simple rectangles, flat vector icons, repeated stick figures or diagram shapes. Wide establishing shot with the entire building well framed and graceful negative space. Painting fades gently into warm ivory paper around all four edges, like a beautiful finished illustration on a whiteboard. Main image content within central 85% of canvas; reserve a blank ivory margin at top 10% and bottom 12% for later text overlays. No typography, letters, logos, captions, marker or hand in image. Deliver finest-quality original cohesive artwork, landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080 or larger.

Leave modest blank paper margins top and bottom for later overlays; content roughly middle 80% but do not reduce it to a small vignette. No typography, logos, existing cartoon characters, marker, pencil or hand overlay. No storyboard grids. Original painting, premium Studio Ghibli-inspired art direction, wide 16:9 composition.
